Subject: EU supply chain VAT mapping & VATID clearance

Hi Lena,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — appreciated the clear product use case. Before we finalize the invoice for the initial committed capacity, finance asked us to confirm a couple of tax points so we can issue the final invoice without payment holds:

1) Please confirm Novasys's VAT ID (full legal entity it applies to) and attach the company VAT certificate. We need an EU-registered VAT number to apply reverse-charge for B2B SaaS where place of supply is the customer.

2) Can you confirm whether the subscription will be billed to Novasys Oy (Finland, VAT: FI12345678) or to the UK entity Novasys UK Ltd? The entity on the invoice determines place-of-supply and withholding rules.

3) Supply chain note: you mentioned a reseller routing for some seats — if any seats are sold through a non-EU reseller, let us know the reseller entity and VAT treatment so we can split invoice lines.

Attached is a draft invoice (INV-20260907-REDWOOD-1234) that currently lists Novasys Oy as the billing entity and applies reverse-charge (net line items). If we don't get VAT evidence, our collections team may need to include VAT on the invoice or place the invoice on hold for tax clearance.

Next steps I'd propose: please reply with the VAT certificate and the exact billing entity by EOD Wednesday. If easier, we can schedule a 15-minute call with our tax ops to accelerate.

Thanks,

--
Dev Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
